articles.title: "Spiderman" makes Tom Holland rich: the astronomical earnings he has achieved with the entire saga
articles.standfirst: A report shows the evolution of his cachet in Hollywood playing the superhero
articles.summary: A report shows the evolution of his cachet in Hollywood playing the superhero
articles.body:
Tom Holland is currently one of the fittest actors in Hollywood . After bringing Telemachus to life and searching for his father in "The Odyssey" by Christopher Nolan , the British artist remains very much present in theaters with "Spiderman Brand New Day" . A report by The Wrap points to the enormous earnings that Holland has achieved playing the Marvel superhero and also highlights the particular contract that multiplies his fortune in the latest film in the saga.

Tom Holland's salaries in "Spiderman"

Tom Holland's first appearance in the saga was in 2016, playing the superhero in "Captain America Civil War" , for which he was paid $250,000 , according to The Wrap. In 2017, he earned $500,000 for "Spiderman Homecoming" . His fee skyrocketed in 2019, when he was paid $4,000,000 for "Spiderman Far from Home" , and it multiplied again in 2021 with "Spiderman No way home" , with a salary of $10,000,000 . That is, in five films, the British actor has earned $14.75 million . And the last one, "Spiderman Brand New Day" , is still to come.

Tom Holland's earnings from "Spiderman Brand New Day"

Established in Hollywood , Tom Holland 's contract for the latest Spider-Man movie is different and far more lucrative. The British actor is guaranteed a base salary of 20 million dollars , but he will also enjoy a percentage of the box office revenue. The success of "Spiderman Brand New Day" in theaters is being overwhelming, and sources consulted by The Wrap do not rule out that Holland 's total earnings could rise, at a minimum, to 100 million .

"Spiderman Brand New Day" grosses 2 billion worldwide

Let's remember that "Spiderman Brand New Day" has so far grossed 2 billion dollars worldwide and has become the eighth highest-grossing film in history. Not counting the bonus for the box office performance of "Spiderman Brand New Day" and taking into account only his guaranteed base salary, Tom Holland has multiplied his earnings in the Marvel saga over ten years, from "Civil War" until now, at a meteoric rate.

articles.title: Dwayne ‘The Rock’ Johnson asks Disney to give his kids ‘free lifetime admission’ to their theme parks
articles.standfirst: The ‘Moana’ star revealed why becoming a Disney Legend means more than another award
articles.summary: The ‘Moana’ star revealed why becoming a Disney Legend means more than another award
articles.body:
Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson has spent years creating memorable moments for audiences around the world, but his latest career milestone quickly became a family celebration.

After being named a Disney Legend , the actor joked that his new title came with a benefit his daughters would be most excited about.

Johnson was honored at the 2026 Disney Legends Awards ceremony in Anaheim, California, joining a group of entertainers recognized for their lasting impact on Disney’s storytelling legacy.

Alongside names including Anne Hathaway , Lin-Manuel Miranda and the Jonas Brothers , Johnson was celebrated for his contributions to the company, particularly through his role as Maui in the Moana franchise.

The honor also became a special moment for his family. Johnson revealed that his younger daughters, Jasmine and Tiana , sent him a heartfelt video congratulating him the night before the ceremony.

“They said, ‘Congratulations, Daddy, you’re a Disney legend. What does it mean?’” Johnson recalled.

Rather than giving them a serious explanation, Johnson decided to have some fun with his answer.

“And I sent them back a video and I was like, ‘It means we get free tickets to Disney for life,’” he joked.

Johnson shares Jasmine , 10, and Tiana , 8, with wife Lauren Hashian . He is also the father of Simone Johnson , 25, whom he shares with former wife Dany Garcia .

While the free tickets comment was clearly a joke, Johnson explained that becoming a Disney Legend represented something much more meaningful than another award.

“I think Disney Legends is something much bigger,” Johnson said. “I believe it’s powerful what Disney does.

"And what it means, in my opinion, to be a Disney legend is to treat people good and treat them with kindness and try your best to create experiences for them that are meaningful for them and their families all over the world.”

A Disney legacy built around family moments

Johnson ’s connection with Disney has grown through his work as Maui, a role that helped make Moana one of the company’s most recognizable modern animated films.

He's set to return as the demigod in the upcoming Moana 3, continuing a character that has become closely linked with his career.

His daughters have also become part of that Disney journey. Johnson revealed that Jasmine and Tiana made brief appearances in the live-action Moana and previously appeared in Moana 2.

“It’s been a great year for my little girls,” he said. During his acceptance speech, Johnson reflected on a memory from when his oldest daughter Simone was five years old.

He recalled taking her to Disneyland for a princess breakfast and watching her make a wish during the experience.

“I just remember that moment on my daughter’s face. I had never seen that before,” Johnson said. “She was just so into making a wish… I said, ‘God, I wonder what was going through the little mind.’”

Joh n son said those moments are what make Disney special for families across generations.

“It’s just experiences like that that we create that I know she’ll never forget,” he said. “I’ll never forget. That’s the beauty of Disney. That’s the beauty also of being a Disney Legend.”

articles.title: Marvel rejected Shaquille O'Neal, as former NBA star reveals why he'll never fulfill dream of becoming actor
articles.standfirst: Executives loved the idea of working with him but believed audiences would never stop seeing the NBA legend
articles.summary: Executives loved the idea of working with him but believed audiences would never stop seeing the NBA legend
articles.body:
Shaquille O’Neal spent his basketball career using his enormous presence to overwhelm opponents. In Hollywood, that same unmistakable presence has created a problem he never expected.

The four-time NBA champion has revealed that he tried for years to secure a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe , including pursuing an appearance in an Avengers movie, but was ultimately told that audiences would struggle to forget they were watching Shaq .

Speaking to Variety while promoting his Dunkman professional dunking league, O’Neal explained that Hollywood executives have repeatedly identified his celebrity as an obstacle when considering him for traditional acting roles.

“I would love to do more action roles but we were told by top Hollywood executives that I’m too big, and what they mean by that is when I pop up on the screen everyone will go, ‘Oh, that’s Shaq!’ So, if I’m trying to play a doctor or anything, my character won’t be believable,” O’Neal said.

At 7-foot-1, O’Neal was already one of the NBA’s most recognizable figures before expanding into television, advertising, music and entertainment. His personality became almost as famous as his dominance with the Los Angeles Lakers , making anonymity on screen virtually impossible.

Marvel gave Shaq brutally simple explanation

That became especially frustrating when O’Neal pursued the franchise he most wanted to join.

The former Lakers, Orlando Magic and Miami Heat center had publicly expressed his interest in appearing in an Avengers movie years earlier. Eventually, he received a direct explanation for why Marvel was reluctant.

“I wanted to be in the ‘Avengers’ and they were like, ‘Shaq, we fuckin’ love you and we’d love to put you in, but if your face pops up on screen people are going to go, ‘Hey, that’s Shaq!’” O’Neal added.

“He said it truthfully, and I was like, alright… I guess my face is too bigtime.”

It's an unusual problem considering Marvel has incorporated some of Hollywood’s most recognizable stars, including Robert Redford, Sylvester Stallone, Angelina Jolie, Christian Bale and Harrison Ford .

O’Neal , however, has already experienced life as a superhero. He starred as John Henry Irons in the 1997 DC Comics adaptation Steel , one year after leading Kazaam .

His movie career didn't end there. Shaq has appeared in projects including Scary Movie 4, The House Bunny, The LEGO Movie and What Men Want , while developing a long-running screen relationship with Adam Sandler. He's also set to appear in Grown Ups 3 .

Next Hollywood target chosen

Missing out on Marvel hasn't completely ended O’Neal ’s ambitions. Instead, the 54-year-old already knows which action star he wants standing opposite him and that is Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson .

“I want to do a movie with The Rock so I can beat him up,” O’Neal said.

Asked whether he genuinely believed he could defeat Johnson , Shaq delivered an answer entirely in keeping with the confidence that defined his NBA career: “Oh, easy! Barbecue chicken.”

Marvel may believe O’Neal is too recognizable to disappear inside one of its characters. His next Hollywood opportunity may therefore need to do the opposite: build the character around the personality audiences already know.

articles.title: Michael B. Jordan as MJ? This is Andrew Garfield's bold proposal for his Spider-Man: "We would have an interracial romance"'
articles.standfirst: In the 2012 and 2014 films, the actor asked Sony for the superhero to be bisexual
articles.summary: In the 2012 and 2014 films, the actor asked Sony for the superhero to be bisexual
articles.body:
A ndrew Garfield portrayed Spider-Man between 2012 and 2014 in two films: ‘The Amazing Spider-Man’ , which were heavily criticized at the time but are now acclaimed. However, few know that the actor, now 43 years old, asked for the superhero to be bisexual, something Sony rejected.

Garfield asked for Michael B. Jordan to be "MJ". He explained this several years ago in an interview with The Independient, noting that, in the end, the studio decided to keep only Emma Stone as Gwen Stacy as Spider-Man's love interest.

'“I’ve been obsessed with Michael B. Jordan since ‘The Wire’. He’s so charismatic and talented. It would be even better, we’d have an interracial romance. I wasn’t joking about MJ. And I was like, "What if MJ is a guy?" Why can’t we find out that Peter is exploring his sexuality? It’s not even groundbreaking! So, why can’t he be gay? why can’t he like boys?” , Garfield wondered.'

“ I worked harder than I have ever worked on anything and I’m really proud of it, but I didn’t feel represented. There was an interview I did where I said, ‘Why can’t Peter explore his bisexuality in his next movie? Why can’t MJ be a boy?’ Then I was really pressured to recant and apologize for saying something that is legitimate to think and feel. So I said, ‘Okay, do you want me to make sure that intolerant people and homophobes buy their tickets?” he said then.

'Michael B. Jordan responds to Andrew Garfield's idea: “Sometimes people don't like it"'

Subsequently, while promoting a film, Michael B. Jordan spoke about Garfield's idea: "I don't have an opinion on it," was the first thing he said.

“I think that many times in comics, if there is a character you have grown up with, and they change them, sometimes people don't like it . If it is about race or other characteristics that cannot be changed and that would be detrimental to the character, I think they should not be changed,” he stated.

articles.title: Rumer Willis, Bruce Willis' eldest daughter, undergoes genetic testing to learn about her predisposition to developing neurodegenerative diseases
articles.standfirst: Let's remember that the actor has been suffering from frontotemporal dementia (FTD) since 2023
articles.summary: Let's remember that the actor has been suffering from frontotemporal dementia (FTD) since 2023
articles.body:
Rumer Willis , the eldest daughter of Bruce Willis and Demi Moore, has undergone genetic testing to learn about her predisposition to developing neurodegenerative diseases . The 38-year-old actress made this decision motivated by the diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia (FTD) that her father has been facing since 2023 , as she commented in an interview with People magazine.

"Sometimes it is frightening to get answers. Obviously, there are genetic issues in my family. Not just dementia; I have also had relatives who have suffered from breast cancer and other illnesses" , she confessed. Rumer specifically underwent the APOE genetic test through the health platform Function. This test analyzes variants of a gene mainly associated with the risk of developing Alzheimer's.

Rumer Willis, Bruce Willis's eldest daughter: “I think that when you have information, you have power”

Although Bruce Willis's diagnosis was the trigger for her to review her brain health , the genomic test she underwent estimates the risk of Alzheimer's. Her father's condition (frontotemporal dementia) is a different neurodegenerative disease that affects different areas of the brain (language and behavior) and whose exact hereditary factors are governed by other markers.

In addition to dementia, she noted that in her family there is a history of other illnesses such as breast cancer. "I think that when you have information, you have power. It sounds very Spider-Man, but when we can see that perhaps we have a greater predisposition to something, we can begin to work actively to reduce inflammation in the body or take care of heart health," she said.

Rummer Willis gave birth to her daughter Louetta in 2023 , also a determining factor in opting for prevention mechanisms. "One of the most important things for me is knowing that the decisions I make have an effect not only on me, but also on my daughter and on my ability to be by her side for as long as possible," she concluded.

articles.title: Tim Curry cause of death: “It” and “Rocky Horror Picture Show” actor dies at 80
articles.standfirst: Legendary performer remembered for Dr. Frank-N-Furter, Pennywise and a career spanning stage, film and television
articles.summary: Legendary performer remembered for Dr. Frank-N-Furter, Pennywise and a career spanning stage, film and television
articles.body:
T im Curry , the acclaimed British actor whose extraordinary career included unforgettable performances in The Rocky Horror Picture Show and Stephen King's It, has died at the age of 80.

Curry died late Tuesday night at his home in Los Angeles, according to TMZ. Law enforcement sources told the outlet that officers responded to his residence at approximately 11:23 p.m., with no foul play suspected.

At this stage, an official cause of death has not been publicly disclosed. Curry had dealt with significant health complications for many years, most notably after suffering a major stroke in 2012.

His representatives and family had not announced a specific cause of death at the time of publication, making it important not to attribute his passing to a particular medical condition without confirmation.

His death marks the end of a remarkable career that stretched across theatre, movies , television and voice acting.

Curry's breakthrough came with The Rocky Horror Show, the stage musical created by Richard O'Brien , before he reprised the role of Dr. Frank-N-Furter in the 1975 film adaptation.

Although The Rocky Horror Picture Show initially struggled to make a major impact with critics and audiences, its reputation changed dramatically.

Midnight screenings helped transform the movie into one of cinema's most enduring cult phenomena, with generations of fans participating in screenings and celebrating Curry's flamboyant central performance.

Curry's distinctive presence also made him a natural fit for darker material.

He played Pennywise the Clown in the 1990 television adaptation of Stephen King's It, delivering a performance that became one of the defining portrayals of the terrifying character.

His interpretation remained influential decades later, even after Bill Skarsgård took over the role for the later film adaptations.

A career that went far beyond his most famous roles

Curry's résumé extended well beyond horror and cult cinema. He appeared as Mr. Hector in Home Alone 2: Lost in New York and took roles in movies including Annie, Clue, The Hunt for Red October, Muppet Treasure Island, Addams Family Reunion and Scary Movie 2.

He was equally comfortable on stage. Curry earned three Tony Award nominations during his theatrical career and became known for performances in productions including Amadeus, The Pirates of Penzance and Spamalot.

His work also extended into animation and voice acting, allowing him to remain active even as physical limitations increasingly affected his ability to appear on camera.

Curry's health changed dramatically in 2012 when he suffered a debilitating stroke. The event left him partially paralyzed and forced him to undergo extensive rehabilitation.

Despite the setback, he continued to work, particularly through voice performances and occasional appearances.

In 2025, Curry released his memoir, Vagabond, offering a personal account of his life and his decades in entertainment. The book explored his childhood, his rise through British theatre, his Hollywood career and the aftermath of his stroke.

Curry reflected that the stroke had limited his physical abilities while emphasizing that his memories and imagination remained intact.

The memoir also provided a reminder that Curry's legacy could not be reduced to one character. While Frank-N-Furter and Pennywise became cultural touchstones, he spent roughly five decades moving between wildly different genres and mediums.

His distinctive voice, theatrical instincts and willingness to embrace unconventional characters made him one of the most recognizable performers of his generation.

For millions of fans, however, Curry will forever be associated with the unforgettable figure at the center of The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

His performance helped turn a relatively unconventional musical into a cultural institution, while his portrayal of Pennywise introduced an entirely different generation to his talent.

Tim Curry leaves behind a body of work that crossed generations. His death closes a remarkable chapter in entertainment, but the characters he created and the performances he gave will continue to introduce new audiences to one of the industry's most distinctive talents.

articles.title: Busy Philipps is facing a difficult situation at age 47: she has a rare malignant brain tumor
articles.standfirst: A routine decision uncovered a serious health problem, and an unexpected complication followed
articles.summary: A routine decision uncovered a serious health problem, and an unexpected complication followed
articles.body:
B usy Philipps has spent much of 2026 dealing with a health crisis that she kept largely private until now, revealing that doctors discovered a rare brain tumor and that she subsequently underwent two operations.

The actress , 47, shared the details of the ordeal in a new interview with PEOPLE, describing the past several months as “the weirdest six months of [her] life.”

She also said she is “grateful to be alive” and reflected on how different her situation might have been if she had not followed through with a medical scan she had seriously considered canceling.

The discovery came on February 12, when Philipps underwent a Prenuvo full-body MRI. She had no obvious symptoms that made a brain tumor seem likely, and she had previously been advised by her primary-care doctor that the extensive scan was unnecessary.

A conversation with her cousin-in-law, internist Dr. Justin Donlan , nevertheless persuaded her to proceed. His argument that “knowledge is power” stayed with Philipps , who ultimately arranged the appointment.

Even then, she nearly abandoned the plan. The appointment had already been delayed from January, and other responsibilities were competing for her attention. Her ex-husband, Marc Silverstein , ultimately encouraged her not to walk away from the examination.

The circumstances surrounding the scan made the result even more difficult to process. Philipps had learned only the previous day that her former Dawson’s Creek co-star James Van Der Beek had died from cancer.

She was therefore facing an intensely emotional moment when the imaging revealed an abnormality.

At first, Philipps attempted to make light of the discovery when communicating with Silverstein. That changed after additional testing.

A neurologist ultimately explained the seriousness of the finding: “This is a real tumor, and it’s inside your brain. And Busy, it’s got to come out.”

The diagnosis was a grade 2 oligodendroglioma. These tumors are relatively uncommon and generally develop slowly, with their symptoms depending heavily on where they occur in the brain.

The first operation was successful, but her recovery took another turn

Doctors removed a 2.6-centimeter mass during a procedure lasting approximately five hours on March 2. The fact that the tumor had been caught relatively early proved significant. Philipps ' neuro-oncologist, Dr. Alexandra Miller , explained that waiting longer could have allowed it to become considerably larger and more difficult to remove completely.

“It is considered malignant, but it has the best prognosis of all of the malignant gliomas,” Miller told PEOPLE. “It’s sort of defined as a cancerous tumor based on the ability of the tumor to regrow over time, rather than it looking very malignant under the microscope.”

Philipps ' treatment did not end with the initial operation. While she was recovering, a dermatologist noticed that something was wrong with the surgical incision. Doctors discovered a staphylococcus infection, requiring Philipps to return for another procedure.

That second surgery proved emotionally difficult because it came after she had already begun to believe that the worst part of the experience was behind her.

“I just felt like I was back to square one,” Philipps explained. “I was really, really upset.”

Despite that setback, Philipps has since returned to work. She began filming her upcoming CBS series Cupertino only weeks after her initial surgery, according to reports about her recovery.

She will continue to undergo regular scans to check for any recurrence. At present, she does not require chemotherapy or radiation, adding another reason for cautious optimism following the surgery.

The experience has also caused Philipps to reconsider certain things she had noticed about herself in the years before her diagnosis.

She had previously told close friend Michelle Williams that she felt as though her “brain is broken,” although there is no definitive indication that every change she experienced was caused by the tumor.

“I’ve been saying this for the last few years,” Philipps noted. “I wasn’t consciously aware that anything was really wrong, but there was something that was misfiring. Like, I could not get a handle on it.”

Now, she says she feels different following treatment.

For Philipps , one of the biggest lessons from the experience has been the value of investigating concerns rather than automatically dismissing them.

“We are frequently told by doctors that there is nothing to worry about [when] you kind of know that there’s something to worry about,” she added. “There’s nothing to be afraid of in having information. It’s only empowering.”

Her decision to go ahead with the scan ultimately led to a diagnosis she never expected. While she still faces long-term monitoring, the early discovery, successful removal and favorable prognosis have allowed the actress to approach the next stage of her life with a renewed sense of gratitude.

articles.title: Bruce Willis' family hit by new controversy as Rumer's ex denies drug use and claims he's being kept from their daughter
articles.standfirst: A bitter custody dispute over three-year-old Louetta.
articles.summary: A bitter custody dispute over three-year-old Louetta.
articles.body:
The family of Bruce Willis has been drawn into another difficult public dispute after his daughter Rumer Willis ' former partner, Derek Richard Thomas , made fresh allegations in their ongoing custody battle.

Thomas filed a declaration in Los Angeles Superior Court on August 27 claiming Willis has deliberately interfered with his relationship with their daughter, Louetta .

He also strongly rejected allegations previously made by Willis concerning his alleged drug use, stating: “I reject completely and without reservation” the claims against him.

Derek Richard Thomas accuses Rumer Willis of blocking visits

Thomas claims Willis has “done everything in her power to interfere, block and frustrate” his relationship with Louetta .

A June 9 custody order granted Willis primary physical custody while allowing Thomas parenting time every other weekend beginning June 20.

According to Thomas , the arrangement initially required six weeks of supervised visits before he could move to “unmonitored and overnight” time with his daughter.

He alleges that Willis repeatedly found reasons to prevent that transition from happening.

Thomas also detailed a July confrontation after he objected to one of the people monitoring a scheduled visit.

According to his filing, Willis eventually arrived at his home with police.

Officers reportedly determined that the disagreement was a “civil matter,” but Thomas claims Willis nevertheless left with Louetta before his scheduled parenting time had ended.

Rumer Willis previously raised concerns over drug use

Willis has presented a very different version of events in earlier filings.

She previously accused Thomas of drug abuse and alleged that his marijuana use had once left him incapable of safely supervising Louetta for even a short period.

Willis has also accused her former partner of emotional abuse and argued that his behavior has negatively affected their daughter. Thomas has denied those allegations.

The former couple have been fighting over custody since July 2025, when Thomas first sought formal custody and visitation rights.

Thomas is now asking the court to preserve the June custody arrangement, while Willis has requested that it be overturned.

Neither side's latest allegations have been proven in court, leaving the dispute over Louetta's care and Thomas ' access to his daughter unresolved.

articles.standfirst: The legendary 1990 film will see Cruise reprise his main character role as Cole Trickle.
articles.summary: The legendary 1990 film will see Cruise reprise his main character role as Cole Trickle.
articles.body:
In a bit of news that came out of seemingly nowhere, Tom Cruise made a major announcement for an upcoming movie of his. Scheduled for a 2028 release, Cruise will apparently reprise his role as Cole Trickle in a sequel to Days of Thunder .

Despite a high production cost of $60 million , the film didn't exactly stick the landing back in 1990 . Overall, the movie had mixed reviews, but it certainly had its place. It became a cult classic particularly among the NASCAR community.

Anne Hathaway to star alongside Tom Cruise in 2028 Days of Thunder film

While details are scarce aside from a scheduled June 2, 2028 release , Cruise's announcement of the movie came alongside Anne Hathaway . It's unclear at this moment what Hathaway's role will be exactly, but it's set to be another major role for the Hollywood superstar.

Hathaway starred in four different 2026 films: Mother Mary , The Devil Wears Prada 2 , The Odyssey , and The End of Oak Street . She will also star in Verity , which is scheduled for release in October. In 2027, she will star in Alone at Dawn . Hathaway is on fire, and busy, at the moment.

Cruise can say the same. Fresh off of shooting back-to-back Mission: Impossible blockbusters, Cruise is set to play the starring role in Digger , which will release on the same day Hathaway's Verity does: October 2 .

A scene that promises fun.

articles.title: 'Bruce Lee, actor and martial artist: "Expecting life to treat you well because you are a good person is like expecting a tiger or a lion not to attack you because you are a vegetarian"'
articles.standfirst: One of the reflections attributed to the legendary performer
articles.summary: One of the reflections attributed to the legendary performer
articles.body:
B ruce Lee was much more than one of the great figures of martial arts cinema . The actor also devoted much of his life to reflecting on discipline, human behavior, and the way of facing problems. Some of those ideas have survived for decades and continue to circulate because of their ability to summarize complex situations with very simple examples.

One of the most striking uses a predator as the protagonist. The comparison starts from an idea that may seem logical, but that Lee quickly dismantles: "doing things right does not mean that the world will always respond in the same way ". Being a good person may be a personal choice, but it does not constitute a guarantee against the difficulties that may arise.

A philosophy based on adaptation

This way of thinking fits well with much of the legacy Lee left behind. For him, strength did not consist solely of having physical ability, but also of knowing how to react when circumstances change. That is why he championed a flexible attitude, one capable of adapting instead of following a path laid out in advance.

That philosophy was also reflected in his conception of the martial arts. Lee developed Jeet Kune Do, a system that rejected excessive limitations and advocated using whatever proved effective in each situation . Adaptation thus became one of the pillars of his thinking.

Its influence ended up transcending films and gyms. T he phrases and reflections he left behind continue to be used as examples of discipline and mindset, even among people who have never practiced martial arts.

The comparison of the tiger and the vegetarian precisely sums up that view . Life does not necessarily work as a reward for our good deeds, and problems can arise regardless of how we behave.

That is why the message does not invite us to abandon kindness, but rather not to mistake it for protection against any adversity . You can act correctly and still find yourself in difficult situations. The key, then, would be to be prepared to face them and know how to adapt when they arrive.

articles.title: Actor Brendan Fraser: "I don't believe that wishing works. I think we get the things we work for"
articles.standfirst: The Academy Award winner believes progress comes from sustained effort rather than simply hoping circumstances will change
articles.summary: The Academy Award winner believes progress comes from sustained effort rather than simply hoping circumstances will change
articles.body:
Brendan Fraser knows what it means to see success disappear, rebuild slowly and eventually return at the highest level.

That history gives unusual weight to one of the American-Canadian actor’s most straightforward observations about ambition and achievement.

“I don’t believe that wishing works,” Fraser said. “I think we get the things we work for.”

It's a deceptively simple idea. Dreams may provide direction, but Fraser ’s point is that hoping for an outcome is fundamentally different from doing the work required to pursue it. His own career offers an obvious example.

Fraser became a major Hollywood star during the 1990s and early 2000s through films including Encino Man, George of the Jungle and The Mummy franchise. His mix of comedy, action and physical performance made him one of the era’s most recognizable leading men.

The trajectory eventually changed. Injuries, surgeries and personal difficulties contributed to a lengthy period in which Fraser was far less visible on major screens.

His return would ultimately become one of Hollywood’s most celebrated comeback stories.

Fraser’s career makes his words difficult to dismiss

Rather than simply attempting to recreate the blockbuster persona that had originally made him famous, Fraser rebuilt his career through different kinds of performances.

That culminated in The Whale, where his portrayal of Charlie earned widespread critical acclaim and the Academy Award for Best Actor.

The achievement came years after the peak of his early fame, reinforcing the idea behind his quote that meaningful progress can require sustained effort even when results aren't immediately visible.

Fraser has spoken about success in similarly reflective terms elsewhere.

“I believe you have a responsibility to comport yourself in a manner that gives an example to others,” he has said. “As a young man, I prayed for success. Now I pray just to be worthy of it.”

That shift in perspective suggests a more complicated relationship with achievement than simply wanting more of it. Success, in Fraser ’s telling, carries responsibility as well as reward.

Why wishing and working are not the same

Fraser ’s original quote also challenges a familiar idea about motivation.

Wishing can be comforting because it allows people to imagine a better career, stronger relationships, improved health or greater financial security without necessarily demanding an immediate change.

Work is different. It requires repetition, discipline and a willingness to continue when there is little evidence that the desired result is coming. That doesn't mean effort guarantees success.

Fraser ’s own career demonstrates how unpredictable circumstances can reshape even the most established path. His message is instead about controlling what can actually be controlled.

“I don’t believe that wishing works,” Fraser said.

Fraser ’s career wasn't defined by uninterrupted progress, and his eventual resurgence was not the product of simply hoping Hollywood would welcome him back.

His story became compelling because he kept moving forward until another opportunity arrived. Dreams can identify what someone wants.

Fraser ’s argument is that action is what gives those dreams a chance to become real.

articles.title: AI could “bring Paul Walker back to life” in the next installment of ‘Fast & Furious’: his brother rules himself out from playing him
articles.standfirst: The actor died in a car accident in 2013
articles.summary: The actor died in a car accident in 2013
articles.body:
"The ‘Fast & Furious’ film saga, or better known by its English title ‘Fast & Furious’, began in 2001, but what no one could foresee or imagine is that 25 years later, the franchise would still be profitable. After 10 films, plus a ‘spin-off’ , the movies starring Vin Diesel are still appreciated by audiences, especially after the death in 2013, in a tragic car accident, of one of the main actors, Paul Walker .

However, with the passage of time and the arrival of new technologies in the film industry, Walker's presence could become a reality in the next release if the words spoken by his brother Cody come true, in an interview with Entertainment Weekly.

Both Cody and his brother Caleb already took part in the seventh installment, as it was during its filming that Paul died. His brothers stood in for him in that movie so the filming could be completed.

articles.title: Emma Heming's heartbreaking confession about Bruce Willis
articles.standfirst: The actor's wife explains how frontotemporal dementia is affecting the whole family and reveals how their daughters are coping with their father's decline
articles.summary: The actor's wife explains how frontotemporal dementia is affecting the whole family and reveals how their daughters are coping with their father's decline
articles.body:
E mma Heming Willis has once again broken her silence about one of the most difficult moments of her life alongside Bruce Willis. The actor’s illness continues to progress, and his wife has acknowledged that living with frontotemporal dementia means, for the whole family, a process marked by pain, but also by love and unity.

In an interview with Hello!, Emma Heming has put into words a feeling that is especially difficult to explain: grieving for someone who is still present. " We are constantly in a state of grief ," she confessed while speaking about how she and the actor's daughters are coping with the progression of the illness.

The wife of the protagonist of "Die Hard" has described the situation as " extremely difficult and painful ", although she wanted to make it clear that Bruce remains very present in his family's life. "We all want our loved ones to be healthy, full of life, and to be who they have always been. But frontotemporal dementia is a devastating disease that slowly takes things away from you ", she explained.

One of the most emotional testimonies in the interview has to do with the actor's daughters and with the way they are experiencing their father's decline. Emma Heming assures that, despite how painful the situation is, the girls are witnessing a genuine lesson in family love. " What our daughters live through and witness at home every day is a masterclass in pure love ," she stated.

The girls see how the family remains by Bruce Willis's side and how friends and loved ones have created a "protective circle" around him. " They see how much we support their father, how much we love him, and how we stand by him through good times and bad ," Emma Heming said, considering that this experience is teaching them " the true meaning of loyalty, devotion, and unconditional love ."

"Bruce still remembers me"

'Emma Heming has also wanted to clear up one of the main misunderstandings surrounding Bruce Willis's illness. The actor does not have Alzheimer's, but rather frontotemporal dementia, a disease that affects other areas of the brain and can cause changes in behavior, personality, and language, among other symptoms. In fact, she says that one of the questions she is asked most when she talks about her husband is whether he still remembers her. " My answer is always a resounding yes ", she stated.'

The businesswoman believes that this question reflects the extent to which some myths about frontotemporal dementia still persist. Therefore, she wanted to stress that Bruce Willis’s diagnosis does not mean that every moment with him is marked by sadness.

Despite the harshness of the process, Emma Heming also wanted to share a message of hope. The actor's wife believes there is an overly negative view of dementia as a disease that turns every moment into suffering. " The idea that dementia is relentless and absolute misery every minute of the day is an absolute myth ," she said.

According to Emma Heming, the family still enjoys everyday moments of happiness and humor. " We have so many everyday moments that still seem funny to us and, fortunately, we keep laughing ," she confessed.

His words thus reflect a complex reality: the progression of a devastating illness coexists with moments of love, complicity, and normality. A way of facing day-to-day life that, for Emma Heming, involves accompanying Bruce Willis through every stage and finding small moments of happiness even in the midst of one of the most difficult times the family has experienced.

articles.title: Hollywood’s newest Instagram star is already threatening to leave
articles.standfirst: Her fans waited years to follow one of the most famous actress of the current generation
articles.summary: Her fans waited years to follow one of the most famous actress of the current generation
articles.body:
Jennifer Lawrence spent years resisting the pull of social media. Now, after more than a decade of insisting she preferred to stay on the sidelines, the Oscar-winning actress has officially joined Instagram. But true to form, she is making it clear that her stay could be short-lived.

Lawrence made her Instagram debut on Sept. 10 under the verified username @jlaw, instantly drawing attention from fans eager to see one of Hollywood’s most recognizable stars finally embrace social media. Her first post, however, came with a warning that was equal parts joke and cautionary tale.

“So, yeah, I’m giving it a shot,” Lawrence said in her introductory video. “And if anyone says anything negative, I will quit. Immediately. No questions asked.”

The actress, known for her sharp wit and self-deprecating humor, didn’t stop there. She jokingly suggested that even criticism that never makes it into the comments section could be enough to send her packing. “If anyone thinks something mean, I’ll know,” she added. “I’ll know. And I’ll quit.”

Lawrence delivered a punchline

The playful threat continued in her first Instagram Story, where she appealed to followers to consider the well-being of a particularly sensitive “baby” before posting anything harsh. “Please be mindful that any mean or aggressive comments can negatively affect the baby,” the message read.

Lawrence then delivered the punchline. “It’s me. I’m the baby.” The debut instantly showcased the personality that has made Jennifer one of Hollywood’s most beloved stars. She leaned into humor and self-awareness, turning her first posts into a comedic bit about the pressures of social media.

Even her profile reflects that approach. Her bio simply states, “jenniferlawrence was taken,” explaining why she opted for the shorter @jlaw handle. Meanwhile, her profile photo features the actress sitting with foils in her hair, drink in hand, and giving the camera a suspicious look—far from the carefully curated image often associated with celebrity accounts.

Lawrence’s arrival on Instagram is especially surprising given her history with social media. In a 2014 interview with BBC Radio 1 , she famously declared that she would never join Twitter and warned fans that accounts using her name were not run by her.

Years later, she maintained a similar stance. During a 2018 interview with InStyle, later cited by Entertainment Weekly, Lawrence described herself as someone who observed social media without actively participating. “I’m on it. But I’m a voyeur: I watch, I don’t speak,” she said.

That philosophy appears to have changed, at least for now. The timing of Lawrence’s social media debut comes as celebrities continue to navigate an online landscape that can be both a powerful promotional tool and a source of relentless scrutiny. Many high-profile actors have embraced direct communication with fans, while others have stepped away from platforms altogether due to harassment, negativity, or concerns about privacy.

articles.title: Sylvester Stallone, actor: "Every champion was once a contender that refused to give up"
articles.standfirst: The Rocky star's message on persistence remains one of his most widely shared lessons.
articles.summary: The Rocky star's message on persistence remains one of his most widely shared lessons.
articles.body:
Sylvester Stallone has built much of his public image around perseverance, resilience and refusing to accept defeat, both through his film characters and the motivational messages associated with him.

One of the quotes most closely linked with the actor captures that philosophy in a single line.

"Every champion was once a contender that refused to give up."

The message fits naturally with Stallone's career , particularly his long association with Rocky Balboa, the fictional boxer whose appeal was never simply about winning. Rocky became a symbol of continuing to fight when the odds appeared overwhelming.

Stallone's message is about refusing to stop

Persistence appears repeatedly in quotes attributed to Stallone , with success presented less as a product of natural talent and more as the result of continuing after setbacks.

"Going that one more round when you don't think you can – that's what makes all the difference in your life."

That idea goes beyond boxing. The message is that progress often depends on continuing at precisely the moment when quitting feels easier.

Stallone has expressed the same theme when speaking about his own approach to success.

"I am not the richest, smartest or most talented person in the world, but I succeed because I keep going and going and going."

Failure doesn't have to be the end

Another recurring part of Stallone's philosophy is that setbacks aren't necessarily evidence that someone should stop trying.

"Every time I've failed, people have had me out for the count, but I always come back."

He has also described rejection as something that can provide motivation rather than a reason to retreat.

"I take rejection as someone blowing a bugle in my ear to wake me up and get going, rather than retreat."

Taken together, the quotes explain why Stallone's words continue to resonate with people facing setbacks in sport, work or everyday life.

His central message remains remarkably simple: champions aren't necessarily the people who begin with the greatest advantages.

They can be the contenders who keep going long enough to give themselves another opportunity to succeed.

articles.title: Cillian Murphy’s son goes viral for kooking exactly like the Oscar winner
articles.standfirst: The moment arrives as Aran begins building a promising acting career of his own
articles.summary: The moment arrives as Aran begins building a promising acting career of his own
articles.body:
The internet has discovered what many fans are calling the closest thing to a real-life copy-and-paste in Hollywood.

Aran Murphy, the 19-year-old son of Academy Award winner Cillian Murphy , is generating massive attention online after a recent red carpet interview went viral, with viewers stunned by just how much he resembles his famous father.

Within hours of being shared across social media platforms, clips of Aran speaking with presenter Jodie McCallum at the premiere of HBO's upcoming comedy-drama Youth accumulated millions of views. While many viewers were interested in hearing about the young actor's rising career, the conversation quickly shifted to something else entirely: the uncanny similarities between Aran and the Oppenheimer star.

For countless viewers, it was more than just a family resemblance. Social media users pointed out that Aran appears to share not only Cillian Murphy's striking facial features, but also his mannerisms, speech patterns, expressions, body language and even the quiet, thoughtful way he answers questions.

The young actor appears in two high-profile HBO projects

The comparisons spread across X, TikTok, Instagram and Reddit, with many users joking that they were watching a younger version of the Oscar-winning actor. Some fans remarked that Aran looked like Cillian Murphy had somehow stepped into a time machine, while others noted that his voice and delivery were so similar that they had to double-check who was being interviewed.

The viral moment arrives as Aran begins building a promising acting career of his own. While comparisons to his father may be unavoidable, Aran Murphy is quickly establishing himself as a talent worth watching.

The young actor currently appears in two high-profile HBO projects .

One of them is Youth , a new romantic comedy created by and starring Sharon Horgan, the acclaimed writer and actress behind Bad Sisters and Catastrophe. The series follows a 50-year-old divorcee navigating relationships, family responsibilities and life changes while raising her adult son, played by Aran Murphy.

The role has already introduced him to a wider audience and helped spark the viral attention surrounding his red carpet appearance.

Aran is also part of War, an HBO legal drama featuring a star-studded cast that includes Dominic West and Sienna Miller.

Of course, any discussion of Aran Murphy inevitably circles back to his father. Cillian Murphy has spent more than two decades building one of the most respected careers in modern film and television. From 28 Days Later and Inception to his iconic role as Tommy Shelby in Peaky Blinders, Murphy became known for his intense performances and unmistakable screen presence.

That reputation reached another level when he won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his portrayal of J. Robert Oppenheimer. Given that legacy, public interest in Aran was always likely. What few people expected was how strongly audiences would react to seeing the similarities between father and son in motion.

Aran's future appears bright beyond his HBO work. He is also part of the ensemble cast for Klara and the Sun , filmmaker Taika Waititi's adaptation of Kazuo Ishiguro's acclaimed science-fiction novel. The film boasts an impressive lineup that includes Amy Adams, Jenna Ortega, Natasha Lyonne and Steve Buscemi, offering another major platform for the young actor to showcase his abilities.

articles.title: How Marvel’s lost ‘Blade’ became Mahershala Ali’s creative redemption
articles.standfirst: The actor struck a surprisingly grateful tone when discussing the experience
articles.summary: The actor struck a surprisingly grateful tone when discussing the experience
articles.body:
After years of uncertainty, delays and unanswered questions surrounding Marvel’s long-awaited Blade reboot, Mahershala Ali appears ready to close the chapter for good.

The two-time Academy Award winner recently revealed that he is officially moving on from the project, ending years of speculation about whether his version of the iconic vampire hunter would ever make it to the big screen.

Instead of expressing frustration, Ali struck a surprisingly grateful tone when discussing the experience, even thanking Marvel Studios for helping pave the way for a completely different project, one that ultimately gave him the creative fulfillment he had been searching for.

According to Ali, the years spent preparing for Blade were not wasted. The actor trained extensively for the role, spending more than a year working on sword combat and stunt sequences as he prepared to bring one of Marvel’s most beloved characters to life. While the film never materialized, those skills found a new purpose.

Multiple creative overhauls derailed the project

Ali put his training to use in Y our Mother Your Mother Your Mother, a new film directed by Bassam Tariq, the filmmaker who was originally attached to direct Marvel’s Blade before departing the project during its lengthy development process.

The unexpected reunion allowed both men to channel years of creative energy into something entirely different from the superhero blockbuster they once envisioned. When Marvel announced Ali as its new Blade in 2019, the casting was widely celebrated.

Fresh off his Oscar-winning performances in Moonlight and Green Book, Ali seemed like an ideal choice to inherit a character made famous on screen by Wesley Snipes. Fans immediately began imagining how the acclaimed actor would fit into the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Yet the project soon became one of the most troubled productions in Marvel history.

Multiple creative overhauls, script revisions, release date changes and behind-the-scenes shifts repeatedly delayed the film. Directors came and went, while reports of ongoing development challenges fueled uncertainty about the project's future. Throughout that period, Ali remained attached and continued preparing for the role. Now, however, he appears ready to leave it behind.

Finding redemption elsewhere

Rather than dwelling on what might have been, Ali has chosen to focus on what emerged from the experience. The actor credited Marvel with helping fund Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother , allowing him and Tariq to pursue a project that ultimately provided a sense of closure.

Perhaps most importantly, the physical preparation originally intended for Blade did not go unused.

The sword work, combat training and stunt experience became valuable tools in his new role, enabling Ali to carry elements of the abandoned Marvel project into a film that finally reached audiences. That transition helped him arrive at a place of peace regarding Blade.

Ali described the process as leaving him feeling "creatively redeemed," a notable statement given how much time and energy he invested in the superhero film. Hollywood is filled with projects that never make it to production, but few receive as much attention as a Marvel title tied to an Oscar-winning actor.

For years, fans wondered whether Ali would eventually step into Blade's signature black leather coat and wield the character's trademark sword on screen. Now, it appears that possibility has officially come to an end.

Fresh off his Oscar-winning performances in Moonlight and Green Book, Ali seemed like an ideal choice to inherit a character made famous on screen by Wesley Snipes. Fans immediately began imagining how the acclaimed actor would fit into the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Yet the project soon became one of the most troubled productions in Marvel history.

Multiple creative overhauls, script revisions, release date changes and behind-the-scenes shifts repeatedly delayed the film. Directors came and went, while reports of ongoing development challenges fueled uncertainty about the project's future. Throughout that period, Ali remained attached and continued preparing for the role. Now, however, he appears ready to leave it behind.
Finding redemption elsewhere

Rather than dwelling on what might have been, Ali has chosen to focus on what emerged from the experience. The actor credited Marvel with helping fund Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother , allowing him and Tariq to pursue a project that ultimately provided a sense of closure.
Perhaps most importantly, the physical preparation originally intended for Blade did not go unused.

The sword work, combat training and stunt experience became valuable tools in his new role, enabling Ali to carry elements of the abandoned Marvel project into a film that finally reached audiences. That transition helped him arrive at a place of peace regarding Blade.

Ali described the process as leaving him feeling "creatively redeemed," a notable statement given how much time and energy he invested in the superhero film. Hollywood is filled with projects that never make it to production, but few receive as much attention as a Marvel title tied to an Oscar-winning actor.

For years, fans wondered whether Ali would eventually step into Blade's signature black leather coat and wield the character's trademark sword on screen. Now, it appears that possibility has officially come to an end.

articles.title: The Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman miracle with Practical Magic
articles.standfirst: It has become HBO’s most-watched title 28 years after the release of the original film
articles.summary: It has become HBO’s most-watched title 28 years after the release of the original film
articles.body:
Almost 30 years later, Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman step back into the roles of Sally and Gillian Owens. The protagonists of a 1998 film return with a second installment that aims to recapture the spirit almost 28 years later in theaters . Despite not succeeding initially, it eventually became a cult title over the years.

The premiere, however, has sparked divided opinions. While some viewers have enthusiastically welcomed the reunion of the Owens sisters and all the nods to the original film, much of the criticism holds that the sequel leans too heavily on nostalgia and does not fully recapture the magic of the first installment.

"The chemistry between Bullock and Kidman remains the main draw

We are talking, of course, about ‘ Practical Magic’, which has recently become the most-watched title on HBO Max . Regarding the second installment, released in theaters this September, one of the aspects that generates the most consensus is precisely the return of its two protagonists. The connection between Bullock and Kidman continues to work, and their scenes together are, for several critics, the best part of the film. The movie also brings back Stockard Channing and Dianne Wiest as the eccentric aunts Franny and Jet.

The story also introduces a new generation of characters, including Sally's daughters, played by Joey King and Maisie Williams. The plot once again revolves around the curse that haunts the Owens family and that once again threatens to change the fate of its members.

But that is precisely the difference between critics and fans. For those who grew up with the 1998 film, reconnecting with the Owens sisters, their house, their spells, and some of their most recognizable elements may be enough to turn the movie into a nostalgic experience.

"Practical Magic 2" thus arrives with a complicated mission: to continue a story that over time acquired a status it never had upon its release. It may not have managed to win over all the critics, but it remains to be seen whether audiences will end up turning this sequel into a new cult classic.

articles.standfirst: Paul Newman’s sharp perspective on success teaches us that true character requires taking firm stands
articles.summary: Paul Newman’s sharp perspective on success teaches us that true character requires taking firm stands
articles.body:
Having no enemies often indicates a reluctance to defend meaningful convictions or make tough choices . In a world driven by continuous social approval, trying to satisfy everyone dilutes personal identity. Newman understood that strong convictions naturally invite opposition, making standing firm essential for developing genuine character and long-term self-respect.

Furthermore, authentic fulfillment comes from living according to clear principles rather than seeking universal popularity . Newman’s multifaceted life as an actor, race car driver, and philanthropist proved that standing up for causes creates lasting impact. In today's fast-paced environment, his timeless wisdom remains profoundly relevant for anyone striving for real personal growth . articles.title: 'Michael J. Fox moves audiences at the 2026 Emmys with his speech: "Accepting Parkinson's didn't mean I had to give up"'
articles.standfirst: The five-time Emmy winner was recognized in this case for his contributions to advocacy and research on Parkinson's disease
articles.summary: The five-time Emmy winner was recognized in this case for his contributions to advocacy and research on Parkinson's disease
articles.body:
Michael J. Fox has lived with his illness, Parkinson’s disease, for many years and every time he appears he is the true reflection of the struggle and the desire to keep going . He has done it again on a stage like the 2026 Emmy Awards . The veteran actor received received the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award , an honor that has been presented six times since its creation, and left everyone deeply moved. His speech defined this gala .

"At first, I kept my Parkinson’s diagnosis a secret. I was worried it would affect my work and my relationship with the public. I was surprised by everyone’s support, I felt very encouraged . I understood that accepting the disease did not mean I had to give up. I had to do everything possible for everyone living with this," the actor said.

He then added: " I set out to advocate for Parkinson's disease and raise funds. I found people to lead this initiative and committed myself to funding the best scientific research in the world. I am proud of the progress we have made for the benefit of patients and their families. We are getting ever closer to the definitive eradication of the disease . I am deeply grateful to our staff, donors, researchers, and the patient community who make our work at the Michael J. Fox Foundation possible".

Its founding: origin and project

The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research was founded in 2000 shortly after publicly revealing his diagnosis, which he learned of in 1991 at the age of 29, at an extremely young age.

For this reason, the five-time Emmy winner was recognized in this case for his contributions to Parkinson's disease advocacy and research .

articles.title: Who is Jennifer Milburn? The young woman rumored to be dating Kevin Costner
articles.standfirst: Costner’s latest public outing put the 40-year-old’s career and connection to Aspen under fresh scrutiny
articles.summary: Costner’s latest public outing put the 40-year-old’s career and connection to Aspen under fresh scrutiny
articles.body:
Kevin Costner has spent much of the past three years navigating a very public post-divorce chapter, and a recent outing in Santa Barbara has now pushed another name into the spotlight.

The Oscar-winning actor, 71, was photographed shopping with Jennifer Milburn , 40, at an Albertsons near his California property, with witnesses describing the pair as “extremely affectionate.”

They reportedly picked up steaks, vegetables, cereal and grapefruit juice before leaving together, a routine errand that quickly became a source of speculation because of Costner ’s recent dating history and the apparent familiarity between them.

What is known is that Milburn has built a career far removed from Hollywood, despite moving in circles that occasionally overlap with Costner ’s world.

Jennifer Milburn has strong ties to Aspen

Milburn is based in Aspen, Colorado, where Costner owns his 160-acre Dunbar Ranch. Her professional background is varied.

She has worked as a Delta flight attendant, modeled for local brands and spent nearly six years with Kemo Sabe, the high-profile western retailer that has become a regular stop for celebrities visiting Aspen.

She now works remotely as director of partnerships for Simon Sinek’s The Optimism Company, according to her LinkedIn profile. That Aspen connection has inevitably added fuel to the speculation surrounding the pair.

Costner has been a longtime presence in the area, while Milburn ’s work with Kemo Sabe placed her inside one of Aspen’s more recognizable lifestyle businesses.

When contacted about whether she and Costner were dating, Milburn reportedly declined to engage and ended the call.

Costner's personal life guarded since divorce

Costner finalized his divorce from Christine Baumgartner in 2024 after an 18-year marriage that ended in a highly public legal dispute.

The former couple share three children — Cayden, Hayes and Grace — while Costner has four other children from previous relationships. Since the split, the actor has been linked to several women.

He was briefly the subject of rumors involving Jennifer Lopez after the two were seen in Aspen, although nothing substantive emerged from the sighting.

Costner was later reported to be seeing filmmaker Kelley Noonan Gores , with one source describing the relationship as “private and casual.” That history makes the latest sighting with Milburn notable, but not conclusive.

Still, the combination of the apparent closeness, the Santa Barbara setting and their overlapping Aspen connections has been enough to make Milburn the latest person tied to Costner ’s evolving personal life.

articles.title: Dakota Johnson's habit that has sparked debate on social media
articles.standfirst: The actress explains it: "I don't function if I sleep less than 10 hours. I can easily sleep 14 hours"
articles.summary: The actress explains it: "I don't function if I sleep less than 10 hours. I can easily sleep 14 hours"
articles.body:
Many boast about getting up early or sleeping only a few hours, but Dakota Johnson argues exactly the opposite. For the American actress, rest is neither a luxury nor a secondary option: it is an absolute necessity .

The actress admitted in an interview with WSJ. Magazine that she needs a lot of sleep to perform in her day-to-day life. "I don’t function if I sleep less than 10 hours. I can easily sleep 14 hours" , she said, and her words quickly went viral, sparking all kinds of reactions on social media.

Johnson explained that she doesn't usually have a set time to wake up and that, when her schedule allows it, she takes the opportunity to catch up on lost sleep. In fact, she considers rest an essential part of her well-being. "Sleep is my number one priority in life" , she stated, making it clear that she adapts her schedule to the demands of each shoot.

However, the actress later qualified those statements during her visit to The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. With her characteristic sense of humor, she clarified that she does not need to sleep 14 hours every night. "I could easily sleep 14 hours. I don't require it. I'm not a monster, I have a job," she joked, downplaying the impact of words that had sparked a lot of discussion.

Other practices of Dakota Johnson

Beyond sleep, Johnson also relies on other practices that help her maintain mental and emotional balance. Among them, transcendental meditation twice a day and various breathing exercises stand out, habits that are part of her wellness routine.

The actress has also shared that relaxing baths are another of her favorite ways to unwind. Contact with water, she explains, helps her reduce stress and find moments of calm in the midst of a schedule often marked by unpredictable hours.

And the fact is that an actress's life rarely follows a fixed pattern. Shoots at ungodly hours, marathon workdays, and constant changes in routine force Johnson to be flexible with her sleeping habits. That is why she avoids imposing rigid schedules and prioritizes listening to her body's needs.

His statements soon went viral , but they also sparked a deeper conversation about the importance of rest and mental health. Many users used the debate to advocate for the need to respect personal rhythms in the face of increasingly demanding work dynamics.

articles.title: Christopher Walken, actor, on life: "At its best, life is completely unpredictable"
articles.standfirst: Walken’s observation offers a reminder that some of life’s most important moments cannot be planned
articles.summary: Walken’s observation offers a reminder that some of life’s most important moments cannot be planned
articles.body:
People spend much of their lives trying to make the future more predictable. They build schedules, set goals, make plans and look for signs that everything is moving in the right direction.

Christopher Walken ’s view of life points in almost the opposite direction: “At its best, life is completely unpredictable.”

The line is brief, but its message reaches beyond simply accepting chaos. It suggests that some of the most memorable parts of life come precisely because they were never part of the plan.

Unexpected opportunities, relationships, changes in direction and even setbacks can alter the course of someone’s life in ways that would have been impossible to anticipate.

Walken ’s point isn't that planning has no value. Preparation can create stability and help people make better decisions. The larger lesson is that no plan can account for everything.

Walken’s own career offers an example of how difficult it can be to predict where a life will eventually lead.

Born Ronald Walken in Queens, New York, in 1943, he began performing as a child and trained in dance before becoming known primarily as an actor.

His career eventually stretched across theater, film, television and music videos, often in roles that were dramatically different from one another.

Walken won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for The Deer Hunter in 1978, but his career never settled into one obvious type of part.

He went on to appear in films including The Dead Zone, A View to a Kill, Batman Returns, Pulp Fiction, Sleepy Hollow, Catch Me If You Can and Wedding Crashers.

Decades into his career, he found yet another audience through Severance. That unpredictability is part of what made Walken ’s body of work so distinctive.

Why letting go of complete control can matter

Many people instinctively treat uncertainty as something negative.

A plan changing can feel like failure. A delayed goal can feel like lost progress. An unexpected turn can seem like proof that something has gone wrong.

Walken ’s quote offers another interpretation. Not knowing exactly what comes next can leave room for experiences that a rigid plan never could.

That doesn't mean every surprise is positive. Illness, loss and disappointment are also unpredictable, and there is no value in pretending otherwise.

The point is that uncertainty itself is not necessarily the enemy. A life controlled down to every detail might feel safer, but it could also leave less room for discovery, spontaneity and growth.

Walken ’s observation works because it doesn't promise that unpredictability will always be comfortable. It simply suggests that the moments people remember most may be the ones they never could have scheduled.

Life doesn't always follow the version people imagine. Sometimes, that is where its most interesting possibilities begin.

articles.title: Nicolas Cage's mansion on verge of collapse: Pictures of the massive sinkhole
articles.standfirst: Crews racing to stabilize the coastline after collapse cut off access to 31 oceanfront homes
articles.summary: Crews racing to stabilize the coastline after collapse cut off access to 31 oceanfront homes
articles.body:
More than a week after a massive sinkhole tore open beside Nicolas Cage ’s Malibu home, the threat hasn't disappeared.

The crater remains a major concern for residents along Sea Level Drive, where the collapse damaged the private roadway, disrupted utilities and left dozens of oceanfront homes dependent on emergency stabilization work.

Aerial images show the scale of the damage: broken pavement, exposed soil and a deep void running close to Cage ’s $10.5 million beachfront property, with heavy machinery positioned around the site as crews continue working.

The sinkhole first opened around 5:45 a.m. on September 8. Officials estimated it at roughly 25 to 30 feet deep and about 30 by 60 feet wide. Cage , 62, bought the home in 2024.

Collapse affected more than one celebrity property

The immediate problem was not limited to Cage ’s mansion. The road failure cut off normal access to 31 homes in the gated community, prompting evacuation orders after officials determined emergency vehicles could no longer safely reach the properties.

Seven homes were red-tagged because of structural concerns, while another 24 were affected primarily by the loss of emergency access. The collapse also damaged utility infrastructure and triggered a gas leak, forcing gas and water service to be shut off in the area.

Adding to the concern, emergency crews had already responded to a gas main break at the same property on September 6, two days before the road gave way. No injuries were reported, and Cage wasn't believed to have been at the mansion when the collapse occurred.

Coastal erosion remains the central concern

Officials have linked the sinkhole to severe coastal erosion rather than any single structural failure.

Powerful surf, high tides and waves associated with Hurricane Marie are believed to have washed away soil beneath the roadway, weakening the ground until it could no longer support the surface above.

That has left engineers and geologists with a difficult task. Crews are working to stabilize the area, protect nearby foundations and install temporary erosion controls before any permanent repair can begin.

The longer-term plan is expected to include filling the crater and rebuilding the damaged roadway, but the immediate priority remains preventing further collapse.

Cage ’s home itself is a large oceanfront property built in the 1990s, with expansive glass walls, multiple bedrooms, a chef’s kitchen, elevator access and a rooftop deck overlooking the Pacific.

Footage from the area suggested renovation work was already underway before the sinkhole opened.

The incident has also revived jokes online about Cage ’s unusual real-estate history, including his former ownership of New Orleans’ LaLaurie Mansion, a property long tied to ghost stories and “curse” folklore.

The danger is real enough with a vulnerable coastline, unstable ground and a neighborhood still waiting to see whether the worst is over.

articles.title: John Travolta reinvents himself again in upcoming crime biopic
articles.standfirst: The actor has repeatedly altered his appearance to bring memorable characters to life
articles.summary: The actor has repeatedly altered his appearance to bring memorable characters to life
articles.body:
John Travolta has built a decades-long career on his ability to disappear into a character, and his latest role may feature one of his most striking transformations yet.

The Hollywood veteran looks almost unrecognizable in the newly released trailer for November 1963, an upcoming biographical crime drama centered on the events surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. Known in recent years for his bald appearance and facial hair, Travolta sports a dramatically different look in the film, complete with slicked-back hair and a sharply groomed mustache as he steps into the role of notorious mobster Johnny Roselli.

The transformation caught the attention of fans, many of whom were forced to take a second look before realizing it was the Grease and Pulp Fiction star beneath the polished mobster exterior. For Travolta, however, dramatic physical changes are nothing new.

articles.body:
Antonio Banderas has spent decades commanding attention on movie screens around the world, but during a recent red-carpet appearance at the Toronto International Film Festival, it was his daughter Stella Banderas who found herself drawing plenty of admiration.

The 29-year-old joined her father for the premiere of Up Against It at Toronto’s Roy Thomson Hall, making a rare public appearance that quickly generated buzz among fans. Wearing a sleek long-sleeved black dress, Stella showcased an effortless elegance while posing alongside the celebrated actor, whose career spans iconic films such as The Mask of Zorro, Philadelphia, Evita, and the beloved Shrek franchise.

Stella’s appearance served as another reminder of how the children of Hollywood stars often carve out their own spotlight. While Antonio remains one of Spain’s most recognizable entertainers, his daughter has steadily built a public profile that blends family ties, international travel, and a visible passion for sports.

A memorable moment during the World Cup

That passion was on display earlier this summer during the World Cup. In July, Stella was spotted attending a match in Los Angeles while proudly supporting Spain, the country of her father’s birth. Wearing a Spanish national team jersey and accompanied by her husband, Alex Gruszynski , she shared in the excitement as Spain competed on soccer’s biggest stage.

The moment became even more memorable when Antonio revealed that he was watching the same match from Málaga, Spain. Sharing photos of their long-distance game-day experience, the actor highlighted the special bond he shares with his daughter despite being thousands of miles apart. “My daughter in Los Angeles, me in Málaga … staying connected and enjoying Spain’s match together,” Banderas wrote alongside the images.

The family connection extends beyond sports. In recent months, Antonio also gave fans a glimpse into the close relationship he continues to maintain with his former wife, actress Melanie Griffith. The pair divorced in 2015 after separating the previous year, ending a marriage that began in 1996. Despite the split, they have remained on good terms and frequently emphasize their commitment to family.

A very supportive family dynamic

One recent social media post showed Antonio, Stella, Alex Gruszynski, and Griffith relaxing together on a couch. The image drew praise from fans who appreciated the former couple’s ability to maintain a strong friendship more than a decade after their separation.

“A lovely and fun moment yesterday in Los Angeles with my son-in-law Alex, my daughter Stella, and my ex-wife and lifelong friend, Melanie,” Banderas wrote.

That supportive family dynamic was evident once again in Toronto, where Stella confidently accompanied her father to one of the entertainment industry’s most prominent festivals. While Antonio remains the established star, Stella’s poised appearance demonstrated why she continues to attract attention whenever she steps into the public eye.
